verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device AI SDK and inference platform with tool calling and agent-style CLI tooling, so consuming tools from MCP servers is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence mentions MCP or plugging in external tool servers. The SDK's tool calling, where a developer registers a function in code, is a developer building block rather than MCP-client support. The integrations page describes pointing third-party tools at RunAnywhere models, which is the reverse direction and an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
